title: Upload a file
description: Create a small file, upload it to Inbox, then download and verify the content.

sections.title: Upload and read back
paragraphs: Run in a shell with LOFT_API and LOFT_TOKEN configured. The example uses a unique ID to avoid replacing an existing file.
sections.code:
set -eu
FILE_ID="hello-$(date +%s)"
printf "Hello from loft.\n" > hello.txt
curl --fail-with-body -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOFT_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Loft-Name: hello.txt" \
  -H "X-Loft-Folder: Inbox" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain" \
  --data-binary @hello.txt \
  "$LOFT_API/v1/files/$FILE_ID/content"
curl --fail -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOFT_TOKEN" \
  "$LOFT_API/v1/files/$FILE_ID/content" -o hello-downloaded.txt
cmp hello.txt hello-downloaded.txt

sections.title: Use your own files
paragraphs: Replace hello.txt, its display name, and its content type with your own file. Keep the returned file metadata if you plan to use version-guarded updates.
